name: GNS Digital QMAP 1:250,000 geology
description: The national regional series of GIS-based 1:250,000 geological maps and their digital derivatives.
story: GNS Science's QMAP programme compiled regional geological mapping at 1:250,000 using GIS. Its digital editions brought mapped geology together with explanatory geological descriptions and an explicit national cartographic framework.

Published regional map files include georeferenced images for GIS use. Seamless geological datasets form a separate related output and should not be confused with the original individual regional QMAP sheets.
